subject: Hosted API evaluation — quickstart & rate limits
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Johnson <sam.johnson@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API evaluation — quickstart & rate limits

Hi Sam,

Great to meet you on the demo this morning — thanks for the thoughtful questions. Quick recap and next steps for the Hosted API evaluation you asked about: 

1) Quickstart: I attached a short Quickstart Guide (redwood_quickstart_guide.pdf) and you can also use the sandbox endpoint at https://sandbox.api.redwood.ai. That should let your engineers exercise the same flows we demoed (chat, streaming, embeddings).

2) API credentials: I created a time-limited sandbox key for your team. Nikhil will send the key to Lina over a secure channel once you confirm the list of engineers who need access.

3) Rate limits & concurrency: The Hosted tier has default rate limits of 60 requests/minute and 5 concurrent streaming connections per org for the free sandbox. For evaluation we can temporarily raise the request QPS to 200/min and 15 concurrent streams — if you let us know expected peak qps and typical sequence lengths (tokens), we can size that properly. For production we offer Dedicated pools for predictable throughput if you need sustained, high-QPS traffic.

4) Data residency & security: Hosted API is SOC 2 compliant; if you need VPC or on-prem for regulated PHI handling we can discuss Redwood Private.

5) Proposed next steps:
   - Your engineering team kicks off the quickstart this week (target: 2 days).
   - Nikhil to share sandbox key and sample curl/postman snippets.
   - We schedule a short sync (30 min) to review results and discuss scaling (Thu or Fri this week).

I also attached an evaluation plan template (eval-plan-template.xlsx) — if you fill the sections for target latency and qps we’ll pre-configure limits for you.

Any questions or constraints I should know about (procurement timeline, security reviewers)?

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
From: Sam Johnson <sam.johnson@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lina Park <lina.park@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-03-22T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API evaluation — quickstart & rate limits

Thanks Marissa — great demo. A couple quick clarifications: 

- Lina (eng lead) will take the quickstart. Please send the sandbox key to her.
- For evaluation: we expect short text classification/triage flows, avg 80 tokens per request, peak around 120 qps but only in short bursts (1–2 minutes). Sustained qps likely ~10–20.
- A couple security asks: can you confirm TLS only, no model training on customer data, and retention window for logs? Our security team will want the POA (proof) for SOC 2.
- Billing: will evaluation traffic incur costs or is this sandbox free?

If Hosted can hit bursts to 120 qps we’re happy to try it; if not we may need to evaluate Dedicated for consistent throughput.

Sam
Dir. of Product, Acme Health
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Johnson <sam.johnson@acmehealth.com>, Lina Park <lina.park@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-22T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API evaluation — quickstart & rate limits

Hi Sam / Lina — looping in Dev (SE) with technical details and the sandbox key next: 

Short answers to your asks: 
- TLS: yes, all API traffic is TLS1.2+ by default.
- Training: Hosted API does not train on customer data. We do ephemeral telemetry for ops; retention is 30 days by default for logs and prompts unless you request a shorter window. We can provide the SOC 2 report and the security questionnaire answers — I attached a short SOC 2 evidence pack link in the evaluation guide.
- Billing: sandbox evaluation is free for the initial trial. If you exceed the temporary raised limits, we’ll alert you and pause additional capacity until you confirm. 
- Rate limits: based on your numbers (120 qps bursts, avg 80 tokens) we can temporarily grant a burst window to 200 qps for the eval period and increase concurrent streams to 15. For production, Dedicated is recommended when you have sustained >50 qps 24/7 or strict latency SLOs.

Sandbox key (shared securely): SK_TEST_abc123 (please do not share externally). Attached are sample curl commands and a Postman collection snippet in the Quickstart Guide.

Proposed: Lina runs quickstart today/tomorrow. Marissa — can you block 30m on Friday for a sync to review results?

—Nikhil
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Lina Park <lina.park@acmehealth.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Johnson <sam.johnson@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-03-23T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API evaluation — quickstart & rate limits

Got it — thanks Nikhil. I’ll start the quickstart this afternoon and validate the burst behavior with a small load test. We’ll confirm by EOD tomorrow and flag any unexpected errors. Friday 10:30am PT works for a sync.

-Lina
Engineering Lead, Acme Health
